answer: Rigorous protocol design achieves a zenith of security by enforcing quadratic slashing where the cost to corrupt a node cluster scales super-linearly relative to stake. This systemic friction creates a sable barrier against Sybil adversaries, ensuring that marginal attack costs surpass prospective gains even across a frozen tundra of liquidity-draining market volatility. By tethering capital erosion to node count, the protocol guarantees consensus integrity under persistent adversarial threat.
